notes: Every scenario runs under --det --perf --no-vsync --mute for a fixed number of SIM frames, ended by --frames=N --screenshot=, which also prints sim_frame= as proof the run reached exactly N.

iterations launches per scenario; the first warmups of them are thrown away (cold OS file cache reshapes a startup profile rather than scaling it -- verification PERF-7). Each measured launch also drops its FIRST perf window, which carries the shader compilation of the first draw.
A record holds MEDIANS: over every kept window for the frame metrics, over the measured launches for the startup phases.
verdictMetrics are the numbers a paired A/B may be read from. awarenessMetrics are recorded and printed but never a verdict -- each carries the reason it cannot be one.

band/minAbs only mark a ratio for attention; nothing fails on them and they are not thresholds. A row is marked only when BOTH are exceeded -- the absolute floor is PERF-5 written down, and without it gpu_ms flags every run on 0.045 ms of jitter over a 0.26 ms number.

The bands below are the same-build floor measured on this machine over TWO back-to-back unchanged pairs. The counts (draws, prims, nodes) came back identical to the digit in all 10 scenario pairings -- they are the sharp instrument here. The ms terms did not: render_cpu spanned 0.981-1.061 (max 0.065 ms), gpu spanned 0.672-1.173 (max 0.215 ms), startup phases spanned 0.911-1.148 once the sub-10 ms ones are set aside, and startup.total 0.977-1.045. The second pair was two to three times noisier than the first, which is why one pair is not a floor (verification METHOD-2, METHOD-3, PERF-5).

Consequence, stated rather than hidden: on these scenes the sub-millisecond ms terms carry little signal, and this suite detects a frame-cost change only from about 0.25 ms and 15 % upward. A change smaller than that has to be caught by the counts or by a scenario built to magnify it.
A history trend is awareness, not evidence. The only regression instrument here is a paired A/B: run the suite, flip the one line under test, rebuild, run the suite again with -PerfCompare.

awarenessMetrics.why: paced by the display or driver, so it is a floor, not a cost (PERF-2)
the same floor as fps; only a value ABOVE the cap means anything
Godot's TIME_PROCESS, ~2.2x real (PERF-1), and it collapses onto the frame cap when the loop is paced
--det makes the clock parent-driven, so _PhysicsProcess consumers no-op and this term is empty by construction
the managed heap high-water, which climbs monotonically inside a run -- read a big step, never a ratio
the worst single frame in a 60-frame window (A2); a median-of-per-window-maxima across a handful of windows is not a distribution with a meaningful ratio
same population as max_ms (A2), same caveat

HitchMonitor trips (PLAN-perf-hitches B4) are rare and bursty by nature, and the run-to-run spread on an unchanged build is not yet measured -- awareness only, per PLAN-perf-hitches E12's own Trap: it records, it never judges (PERF-5, METHOD-3)

scenarios.name: empty-stage
scenarios.exercises: no gamez at all: the synthetic stage, flight model, HUD, plane build. The control -- a world, clutter or animation change must leave this scenario alone

scenarios.name: c1-flight
scenarios.exercises: the only moving camera in the set: a flying plane over C1, chase camera, prop and control-surface animators, gauges, HUD, collision raycasts, forest clutter

scenarios.name: c2b-water
scenarios.exercises: open water plus rain: the precipitation multimesh, the water flipbook, the lightest world in the set

scenarios.name: c4-terrain
scenarios.exercises: the heaviest draw-call pose in the set (~2180 calls) -- dense terrain, snow precipitation and the chapter's UV-scroll models

scenarios.name: c5-city
scenarios.exercises: the night city: the largest clutter build in the set (solid 3D blocks, collidable) and the LIGHT_STATE point-light data texture
